planets.name: Kepler-1649 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-1649 with a 8.69-day year, found in 2017.

text.card: Kepler-1649 b was found in 2017 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 2 planets known around Kepler-1649. Its orbit and size follow Vanderburg et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname VANDERBURG_ET_AL__2020): disc_year 2017, disc_facility Kepler, sy_pnum 2; pl_orbper 8.689099, pl_radj 0.09073066, pl_bmassj 0.00325

quotes.title: Kepler-1649b
quotes.card: Kepler-1649b is an exoplanet orbiting the red dwarf star Kepler-1649, discovered in 2017.
quotes.introduction: It is similar to Venus, but in the past it was thought to be a candidate for habitability.
